title: Story premise ENT059: The Nine-Tile Mosaic
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (mechanical puzzles). Hook: Every row wants all three shapes. Takeaway/theme: Check constraints in both directions when the puzzle promises both.
description: An artist must fill a 3-by-3 board with nine tiles so each row shows one circle, one square, and one triangle. The first attempt repeats a circle; they rearrange rows as circle-square-triangle, square-triangle-circle, triangle-circle-square, producing rows and columns with one of each.
